title.narrative: Fostering an Inclusive and Shock-Responsive Social Protection System in Cambodia (FIRST)

SP4ALL Platform has been functioning. In 2022 the team focused on governance structure memberships logo website planning for 2023 and regular meetings to strengthen their work. In 2023 this platform consists of 20 core members and Oxfam were elected as secretariat for 2year terms. DPOs Networks were strengthened by CDPOs and engaged in social dialogues through regular Quarterly Network Meeting engaged by MoSAVY GSNSPC MoP NEA. OPAs Provincial Networks were established and strengthened by HAC and engaged in social dialogues through leadersrepresentatives. The networks connected ssto GSNSPC MoSAVY MoP Provincial Offices Commune Councils and Health Centre.
